benchlmStats.label: Frontier price drop since March 2023
benchlmStats.sentence: Frontier LLM token prices are 88% below their March 2023 level as of July 2026, per the BenchLM Token Price Index (12 on a base of 100).

benchlmStats.label: Price direction, last 12 months (frontier vs mid-tier)
benchlmStats.sentence: Over the 12 months to July 2026, the BenchLM Token Price Index shows frontier LLM token prices up 36.4% year-over-year, while mid-tier prices went down 35.8%.

benchlmStats.label: Models with tracked API pricing
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, BenchLM tracks live API pricing for 120 AI models.

benchlmStats.label: Median price per 1M tokens (input / output)
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, the median LLM API price across 120 models tracked by BenchLM is $1.00 per 1M input tokens and $3.49 per 1M output tokens.

benchlmStats.label: Spread between cheapest and most expensive model
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, the most expensive LLM API tracked by BenchLM (o1-pro) costs roughly 2625x more per blended 1M tokens than the cheapest (Ministral 3 3B).

benchlmStats.label: Cheapest frontier-tier model (top 10 overall)
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, the cheapest model in BenchLM's overall top 10 is Gemini 3.1 Pro at $2.00 per 1M input tokens and $12.00 per 1M output tokens.

benchlmStats.label: Open-weight median discount vs proprietary
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, open-weight models on BenchLM have a median blended API price 82% lower than proprietary models ($0.48 vs $2.63 per 1M tokens at a 3:1 input:output ratio).

benchlmStats.label: Model releases tracked in the last 12 months
benchlmStats.sentence: BenchLM tracked 90 AI model releases in the 12 months ending 2026-06-30 — a notable model release roughly every 4 days.

benchlmStats.label: Open-weight share of releases (12 months)
benchlmStats.sentence: 44% of the 88 classified AI model releases BenchLM tracked in the 12 months ending 2026-06-30 were open-weight models.

benchlmStats.label: Busiest release month
benchlmStats.sentence: April 2026 was the busiest month for AI model launches in the last year, with 20 releases tracked by BenchLM.

benchlmStats.label: Most active lab (12 months)
benchlmStats.sentence: OpenAI shipped the most tracked model releases in the 12 months ending 2026-06-30 (13), ahead of Anthropic (9) per BenchLM release data.

benchlmStats.label: Largest context window tracked
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, the largest LLM context window tracked by BenchLM is 10M tokens, offered by Meta's Llama 4 Scout.

benchlmStats.label: Share of models with a 1M+ token context window
benchlmStats.sentence: 23% of the 272 AI models with published context windows tracked by BenchLM offer 1M tokens or more as of July 4, 2026.

benchlmStats.label: Median context window
benchlmStats.sentence: The median context window across all AI models tracked by BenchLM is 200K tokens as of July 4, 2026.

benchlmStats.label: What 1M tokens holds
benchlmStats.value: War & Peace (~750K tokens) + a full novel
benchlmStats.sentence: A 1M-token context window — offered by 62 models tracked by BenchLM as of July 4, 2026 — fits the full text of War & Peace (roughly 750,000 tokens) with room left for an average novel.

benchlmStats.label: Benchmarks tracked
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, BenchLM tracks 251 LLM benchmarks across 10 categories for 272 AI models.

benchlmStats.label: Benchmark saturation rate (top score ≥ 90/100)
benchlmStats.sentence: 37% of the 154 percentage-scaled benchmarks with meaningful coverage on BenchLM are saturated — the top model already scores 90 or higher — as of July 4, 2026.

benchlmStats.label: Models meeting ranking eligibility
benchlmStats.sentence: Only 124 of the 272 AI models tracked by BenchLM (46%) have enough sourced benchmark coverage to qualify for ranking as of July 4, 2026.

benchlmStats.label: Open-weight share of the overall top 50
benchlmStats.sentence: As of July 4, 2026, 17 of the top 50 AI models on BenchLM (34%) are open-weight.

benchlmStats.label: Highest-ranked open-weight model
benchlmStats.sentence: The highest-ranked open-weight model on BenchLM is DeepSeek's DeepSeek V4 Pro (Max), at #13 overall as of July 4, 2026.

benchlmStats.label: Score gap: top proprietary vs top open-weight

benchlmStats.label: Open-weight share of all tracked models
